newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 589c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 589c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market was steady at auctions in Sydney and Adelaide on Thursday, leaving the eastern market indicator on 589 cents a kg clean, Wool International (WI) said.
In merinos, the 19 micron category was unchanged.
The 20/21m indicators were slightly cheaper, 22/25m were slightly dearer and 23/24/26m up to 0.5 percent dearer, it said.
In crossbreds, 27m was slightly dearer, while 28/29/30/31m were unchanged.
There was good general competition with most sectors of the trade active including China and local mills, WI said.
Of the 19,975 bales offered, 12.8 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 106,000 bales on offer.
